issues.what: the fleshy, wet, glossy crimson kelp-like organism with a thick holdfast in -a is replaced by dry, feathery, matte rust-brown pampas-like plumes on thin dark stems
issues.fix: replace the dry feathery plumes with wet, fleshy, branching crimson fronds anchored by a thick root-like holdfast and lit with translucent ruby backlighting

issues.what: the tall, slender, four-legged pale creature standing in the sunlit mist in -a is completely missing
issues.fix: restore the slender long-legged creature standing on the sunlit wet flats in the background haze

issues.where: the lighting and colour across the frame
issues.what: the warm golden low-sun backlighting, bright water reflections, and rich ruby-and-amber contrast of -a are flattened into dull, cool, muddy grey-beige light
issues.fix: add strong warm golden-hour backlighting from the upper-left, bright specular reflections on the wet flats and fronds, and deeper contrast

issues.where: the interior walls of the chasm
issues.what: the smooth, pale, curved rib-like bone/mineral arches with deep recessed vertical walls in -a are replaced by jagged, dark grey-brown rocky strata and blocky rectangular boulders
issues.fix: rebuild the pit interior with smooth, pale, curving rib-like arches stained with wet rust and moss, separated by deep recessed dark walls

issues.what: the bright golden-hour sunlit wet flats with multiple wading long-legged creatures and warm rim light on the pit lip in -a are pushed nearly out of frame and dimmed to flat grey-pink
issues.fix: lower the horizon slightly to show the glowing sunlit flats and silhouetted creatures, and cast warm golden rim light across the upper lip of the pit

issues.where: the overhanging red growth on the left and top-center
issues.what: the lush, wet, dripping crimson tendrils framing the left in -a are reduced to sparse, dry, flat rust-brown fronds with an intrusive tuft hanging from the top-center
issues.fix: replace the sparse dry fronds with dense, wet, dripping crimson tendrils overhanging the left edge and remove the distracting top-center tuft

issues.what: the foliage reads as thin, flat, matte alpha-cutout cards with dark spline stems and aliased edges rather than wet, glossy, translucent organic tendrils
issues.fix: give the fronds volumetric, wet, glossy geometry with fine translucent filaments and specular rim highlights instead of flat cutout cards

issues.where: the full-size pit rim and wall crops
issues.what: the rock surfaces look stretched, blurry, and matte with smeared procedural noise, lacking the crisp, wet, pitted mineral/bone texture, sheen, and dripping water threads of -a
issues.fix: increase geometric and texture detail on the pit walls and rim, and add wet specular sheen, mineral staining, moss, and fine dripping water

issues.where: the foreground rock ledge and plant base
issues.what: the craggy, wet layered stone with scattered pebbles and a small bleached bone in -a is replaced by a smooth, lumpy, low-detail grey surface with a sharp polygonal rim edge
issues.fix: add detailed craggy rock geometry, wet sheen, loose pebbles, grit, and the small bone around the holdfast

issues.where: water droplets around the foreground fronds
issues.what: instead of delicate glistening drops hanging from frond tips as in -a, small white-grey streaks float scattered over the lower stems and rock
issues.fix: remove the floating white streaks and attach realistic glistening water droplets hanging and dripping from the frond tips

issues.where: the upper-right distant cliff and chasm rim
issues.what: the distant cliff is too dark, close, and cuts off along a flat horizontal fog line, while the curved pale pit overhang on the right of -a is missing
issues.fix: push the distant cliff further into soft atmospheric haze with a natural mist transition, and restore the curved pale chasm rim on the right

issues.where: the vapour in the chasm and the bottom foreground corners
issues.what: the steam is a uniform murky brownish cloud lacking -a's soft backlit layers, and an unrelated flat grey-striped rock lip intrudes at the bottom-right while -a's soft rocky ledge at bottom-left is missing
issues.fix: soften and layer the rising vapour with warm backlit depth falloff, remove the intrusive bottom-right rock lip, and frame the bottom-left with a soft-focus rocky edge
